script:
R=$(control-agent-server conversation start --body-json "{\"agent\": $SIDE_AGENT}" --no-autotitle --prompt QA_F10_BUSY --print-id)
control-agent-server conversation wait "$R" --until running --timeout 30
control-agent-server sink read --name qa-f10-side --expect-min 1 --expect-max 1 --wait 30
N_R=$(control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$R/events/count" --field .)
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$R/ask_agent" --json '{"question": "QA_F10_SIDE_Q"}' --expect 200 \
  --check response eq QA_F10_SIDE --expect-max-ms 15000 --timeout 60 --save F10.ask-agent-running/ask
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$R" --quiet --check execution_status eq running --save F10.ask-agent-running/still-running
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$R/events/count" --check . eq "$N_R"
control-agent-server sink read --name qa-f10-side --contains QA_F10_SIDE_Q --expect-min 1 --expect-max 1
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$R/interrupt" --expect 200 --quiet
control-agent-server conversation wait "$R" --until paused --timeout 30
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$R/events/count" --query body=QA_F10_SIDE --check . eq 0
